d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

d: The Inside Sales Specialist is responsible for managing spot sales activities, preparing proposals and presentations, and ensuring accurate handling of quotations and documentation. The role supports the sales team by identifying growth opportunities and providing seamless customer experience to strengthen business relationships.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business, logistics or a related field
Strong communication, negotiation and customer-handling skills
Proficiency with CRM tools and Microsoft Office
r: Identify, pursue, and secure export business opportunities to achieve sales targets
Build and maintain strong relationships with logistic providers and overseas partners to ensure long-term business growth.
Prepare and manage customer quotations, ensure timely follow-up, and handle related documentation with accuracy.
Collaborate with overseas agents to manage and facilitate export processes, documentation, local charges and compliance.
Work closely with sales operation and customer service & operations to ensure seamless and timely service delivery.
Monitor international market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to provide input for sales strategy.
Prepare regular sales performance reports and provide insights for management decision-making.
Update CRM or manual tools and internal systems with customer requirements, ensuring alignment with sales team inputs.
All Sales members are required to submit weekly forecast to the sales operations in order to get alignment and approvals for space and equipment.
Each sales member needs to submit quarterly forecast to align with the budget requirement by lane by customer.
